sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Sabriel: Sophie's Titan''' is almost impossible to take down! Her Supertough power lets you exhaust a [[:Category:Major Hero cards|major hero]] to save her when she would be KO'd, so the trick is to use major heroes that you can keep safe and readied. [[SAS-022|Sophie Casterwill: Heir of the Casterwills]] and [[SAS-005|Furoji: Calm Center]] both have powers you can use for free, so you should play those heroes alongside Sabriel they'll be there to save her and send her back into the fray!
